## Summary

What does this change do?

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Browser-tested when the change affects the UI

## Privacy and security

- Does this change handle user-controlled data?
- Does it change what is stored, exported, or sent?
- Does it introduce a new dependency or external request?

## Checklist

- [ ] No real account data, credentials, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Screenshots use fictional data only.
